title: P-recursive structure of the all-s j=1 containers and its arithmetic limit

artifacts.role: global proof, admission audit, and strict scope
proposed ledger delta; no canonical edit

proved: The exact Item-308 rational and Gaussian aggregate sequences have explicit all-s algebraic constant-term generating functions.
A_s,U_s,V_s,a_s,b_s,0,b_s,1,D_s,0,D_s,1 are P-recursive; the cleared container sequences are integral.
The quadratic parameter delta_s,epsilon*eta_s is a square modulo every actual candidate prime class, so norm splitting excludes no candidates.
For every fixed K>=7, P_s^(K)=product_(k=7..K) binomial(k*s,s) is positive, first-order P-recursive, and has logarithmic height O_K(s).
Every prime 6s<p<=Ks divides P_s^(K), by k=ceil(p/s) and an exact valuation-one argument.
The comparison's exact fixed-M logarithmic mass is ((K-6)/(2(3K-2)))M+o(M), tending to raw M/6.

capacity.reason: Qualitative P-recursiveness, exponential height, nonvanishing, and norm shape allow tied-prime mass arbitrarily close to the raw support.
